title: build a spec to turn the wake page into columns similar to fizzy.do: draft, in-progress, and done from left to right cards like kanban style and with the draft to have approve deny but also you can click on the card and it expands into the current card that says run pipeline, etc

userStories.title: Create Kanban column layout structure
userStories.description: Implement a three-column horizontal layout for the queue page with 'Draft', 'In Progress', and 'Done' columns. Replace the existing list view with a Kanban-style board using CSS Grid or Flexbox.
acceptanceCriteria: Three columns are displayed horizontally: Draft (left), In Progress (center), Done (right)
Column headers show the status label and spec count badge
Columns have equal width and take full viewport height minus header
Layout is responsive and handles overflow with vertical scrolling per column
Empty columns show a placeholder message

suggestedSkills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
suggestedSkills.reason: Layout component will benefit from React performance patterns for list rendering

suggestedSkills.name: tailwind-design-system
suggestedSkills.reason: Three-column grid layout requires Tailwind responsive design patterns and spacing tokens

userStories.title: Create spec card component for Kanban view
userStories.description: Build a compact card component to display spec summary information in the Kanban columns. Card should show spec title, story count, and status indicators in a condensed format suitable for column layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Card displays spec title truncated to 2 lines with ellipsis
Card shows story count badge (e.g. '12/15 stories')
Card has hover state with subtle elevation change
Card is clickable and navigates to expanded view
Card height is fixed to prevent column height mismatches

suggestedSkills.name: tailwind-design-system
suggestedSkills.reason: Card component requires design tokens for spacing, hover states, and truncation patterns

suggestedSkills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
suggestedSkills.reason: Card list rendering needs optimization for large spec counts

userStories.title: Update queue route to fetch specs grouped by status
userStories.description: Modify the backend /api/specs or /api/queue route to return specs grouped by status (pending, approved/running, archived). Frontend will use this to populate the three Kanban columns.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/queue returns JSON with three arrays: draft, inProgress, done
Draft array contains specs with status='pending'
In Progress array contains specs with status='approved' or active runs
Done array contains specs with status='archived'
Response includes spec metadata needed for card display (id, title, story count, timestamps)

suggestedSkills.name: rorca
suggestedSkills.reason: Route modification requires understanding Rorca's spec and pipeline status model

userStories.title: Wire spec cards to grouped API data
userStories.description: Connect the Kanban columns to the grouped API endpoint. Each column fetches and displays cards for its respective status group.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft column displays specs from draft array via apiFetch
In Progress column displays specs from inProgress array
Done column displays specs from done array
Loading states shown while fetching data
Error states handled gracefully with retry option

suggestedSkills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
suggestedSkills.reason: Data fetching patterns and loading/error state management align with Vercel best practices

suggestedSkills.name: rorca
suggestedSkills.reason: Integration with Rorca's apiFetch utility and workspace context is required

userStories.title: Add approve/deny actions to Draft column cards
userStories.description: Add approve and deny action buttons to each card in the Draft column. Clicking approve moves spec to In Progress, deny archives it.
acceptanceCriteria: Each Draft card shows approve (checkmark) and deny (X) icon buttons on hover
Approve button calls POST /api/specs/:id/approve and moves card to In Progress column
Deny button calls POST /api/specs/:id/reject and removes card from Draft
Actions show loading spinner and disable buttons during API call
Success/error toasts shown after action completes

suggestedSkills.name: rorca
suggestedSkills.reason: Approve/reject API endpoints are core Rorca spec lifecycle operations

suggestedSkills.name: tailwind-design-system
suggestedSkills.reason: Button hover states and loading spinners use design tokens

userStories.title: Implement card click to expand into detail view
userStories.description: When a card is clicked, expand it into a full detail view showing all spec information and actions (Run Pipeline, Edit, etc.). Use SlideOver pattern from existing Run View.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a card opens SlideOver with full spec details
SlideOver shows spec title, all user stories, acceptance criteria, and dependencies
SlideOver includes 'Run Pipeline' button (Draft/In Progress only)
SlideOver includes 'Edit' and 'Delete' actions
Closing SlideOver returns to Kanban view without losing scroll position

suggestedSkills.name: rorca
suggestedSkills.reason: SlideOver navigation pattern and spec detail display are existing Rorca patterns to follow

suggestedSkills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
suggestedSkills.reason: SlideOver state management and scroll position preservation need optimization

userStories.title: Add Run Pipeline action to expanded card view
userStories.description: In the expanded card SlideOver, add a 'Run Pipeline' button that triggers the pipeline for the spec. Button should only appear for specs in Draft or In Progress columns.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Run Pipeline' button visible in SlideOver for pending and approved specs
Button disabled for archived specs with tooltip explaining why
Clicking button calls POST /api/pipeline/trigger with spec path
Success response navigates user to Run View (#/run/:runId)
Error response shows toast with failure reason

suggestedSkills.name: rorca
suggestedSkills.reason: Pipeline trigger API and navigation to Run View are core Rorca execution flows

userStories.title: Real-time column updates via SSE
userStories.description: Subscribe to /api/pipeline/stream SSE endpoint to automatically move cards between columns when specs are approved, pipeline starts/completes, or specs are archived.
acceptanceCriteria: Component subscribes to SSE on mount and unsubscribes on unmount
spec_approved event moves card from Draft to In Progress
run_started event updates In Progress card with active run badge
run_finished event moves card from In Progress to Done
spec_rejected event removes card from Draft column

suggestedSkills.name: rorca
suggestedSkills.reason: SSE integration with WAL events is a core Rorca real-time sync pattern

suggestedSkills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
suggestedSkills.reason: SSE subscription lifecycle and state updates need React optimization patterns
